projects.title: Engineering with purpose
projects.description: From professional web platforms to independent AI experiments, here is how I translate requirements into working software.

agrinfo.overview: AGRINFO helps agri-food stakeholders understand changing EU regulatory requirements and their implications for market access.
contributions: Contributed to development of the AGRINFO platform.
Worked within a Python, Django and Wagtail-based stack.
Used PostgreSQL and frontend technologies in a content-rich application.
Collaborated within a professional development environment.

agrinnovators.tagline: Building a platform for agri-food innovation
agrinnovators.overview: A digital platform supporting agri-food innovation, entrepreneurship and knowledge sharing.
contributions: Implemented the website using WordPress and Divi.
Developed custom PHP, JavaScript, jQuery and CSS functionality.
Created custom post types, ACF fields and dynamic content queries.

ai-employees.tagline: VoltHub: a Django store with guardrailed AI customer support
ai-employees.overview: A working online electronics-store demo where customers can browse products, check out with Stripe test mode, track orders and chat with Aura, a Claude-powered support agent. Refund and damage cases can be escalated to Manager and Risk agents, with code-enforced safeguards; refund approvals flagged as high-risk or above €1,000 are held for human review. Staff can inspect conversations and agent activity in a live dashboard. Policy documents are loaded into ChromaDB; connecting document retrieval to Aura remains on the roadmap.
contributions: Built a responsive Django storefront with a product catalog, customer accounts, order history and Stripe Checkout; orders are created only after payment is confirmed.
Implemented a shared Claude tool-use loop for Aura, the Manager Agent and the Risk Agent, with order tools scoped to the current conversation.
Added explainable customer-risk signals and code-enforced refund safeguards; approvals flagged as high-risk or above €1,000 are held for human review.
Built a staff-only support dashboard with live agent activity via Server-Sent Events and persistent conversation logs.
Added 30 automated tests covering risk checks, refund safeguards, multi-agent handoffs and the dashboard.
